_read_me: Every review on the website comes from this file, word for word.
A review's 'text' is the client's own words as we've published them. Some have a longer and a shorter version; both are kept so a page can quote either.

A quote on a page must be an exact piece of one of these texts. _src/build.py stops the build if a quote has been reworded, if its caption isn't this review's caption or short caption, or if the same sentence appears twice on one page.
Never write, merge or tidy up a review here beyond fixing a typo. To add one, paste it in full under a new id with a caption that says what the event was (never the client's name).
'nudges' are the short lines shown by the Get a quote buttons on computers (assets/js/site.js). They're checked the same way, and can't repeat a quote already on the page.

listed-building-wedding.caption: Wedding at a listed building, booked 13 days before
text: ORPI rescued our wedding with less than two weeks’ notice, delivering an impeccable service across a complex day of events while navigating the many special conditions and procedures of a listed building. They were professional, relaxed, brilliant with guests and really added to our day.

ORPI rescued our wedding with less than 2 weeks’ notice, delivering an impeccable service across a complex day at a listed building. Professional, relaxed, brilliant with guests — I received a ton of compliments from guests on both their service and drinks.

ORPI stepped in with 13 days to go. They organised a drinks tasting at our flat within days, sourced all necessary glassware, served signature cocktails all night, and even served drinks to the dinner table — going above and beyond at every turn. I wholeheartedly recommend ORPI for delivering to the highest standards.

wedding-reception.caption: Wedding reception
text: The cocktails and mocktails were a HIT! A week later, people are still raving about how good it was. ORPI will always be a highlight of our reception.

private-event.caption: Private event
text: From the drinks to staff and service, everything was 10/10 and I didn’t have to worry about a thing. They really made my event special.

30th-garden-party.caption: 30th birthday garden party
text: Both service and drinks were 10/10. The energy the team brought made the event one that our family and friends won’t forget. The passionfruit martini was a firm favourite.
The passionfruit martini was a firm favourite, and don’t miss out on the lychee martini with the bubble: a sure showstopper.

company-party.caption: Company party
text: They turned up big time and were my favourite supplier to work with. They delivered the vibes we didn’t even know we needed. Now I understand what a bar company brings to the party.

first-birthday.caption: First birthday
text: Ruds and his team were so friendly and incredibly accommodating. As a mum hosting a big first birthday, there’s always so much going on — they even helped warm baby bottles. Those small acts of kindness made such a difference.
As a mum hosting a big first birthday, there’s always so much going on, and they even helped us with things like getting hot water to warm baby bottles.
